dedupe_keys.name: hourly dynamic emission factors for the turkish electricity grid 2022 2024

description: Hourly dynamic emission factors for the Turkish electricity grid, 2022–2024 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tuğba ULUTAŞ, Ünal KURT (Amasya Üniversitesi). This record contains the verification workbook supporting the article "Decomposing Türkiye's Official Grid Emission Factor: Hourly Resolution, Publication Lag, and Limits of Reconstruction" (Ulutaş & Kurt). Period: 2022–2024 (26,304 hours)Data sources: EXIST (Energy Exchange Istanbul) Transparency Platform real-time and unlicensed generation data; MENR source-based emission factors; TEİAŞ generation statistics. Contents DEF_Dogrulama.xlsx, the verification workbook. Coverage: national (TR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
